api.stake: Total locked round bet in currency units; also accepts {totalCents} or {totalStake}. A different continuation stake is rejected.
api.config: Create locks its cloned config in bonusState._local.config. Continuation uses the locked config, not later external overrides. Pass config.spinId=the owned round id; config.id is the token namespace fallback.
api.awardCents: INCREMENTAL pending-round award delta in integer cents, not totalWinnings and not an immediate cash-wallet credit. Wallet must add delta once to pending award and only credit balance at final closeSpin.

deltaByType.elixirFurnace: 0 during purify and nonterminal successful gambles; whole final candidate on collect(gamble,false) or third successful gamble. Loss gives0.
deltaByType.jpGame: 0 until the third matching category; then the selected local pool award.
deltaByType.fortuneLanding: Each previously uncollected token emits that box amount once; finish emits0 and forfeits unopened/missed boxes.
deltaByType.luckyWealth: create already returns isFinish=true/prize and the award delta; native game has no further bonus action before closeSpin.

api.pure: No mutation of input state/payload/config, wallet, storage, timers, network or original client. Wallet must persist returned bonusState even when delta is0.

idempotency.ids: operationId > requestId > localActionId. Purify and gamble(true) require a stable logical id; raw native identical next-step requests are ambiguous.
idempotency.transportHook: Owned transport uses WeakMap keyed by each new original payload object; assign one localActionId per logical invocation and preserve it across same-object retries. New identical-content payloads get a new id. Explicit operationId/requestId take precedence.
idempotency.cache: bonusState._local.responses stores signature and the public response snapshot, excluding _local to avoid recursive growth. Retry returns latest state unchanged, delta0, replayed:true and cachedResponse for the original logical outcome. Never roll wallet state back to an older cached snapshot.
idempotency.naturalKeys: JP is deduplicated by already-opened position; fortune by exact local treasure token, including after finish. Collect/finish repeats never re-award. Transport token rotations are not treated as action changes except fortune where token identifies a specific box.
idempotency.conflict: Reusing a logical id with different action/value/spin contents is rejected.

elixirFurnace.fourthPurify: action changes to gamble, purifyTimes is ready. No gambleResults until first gamble request, so original BonusGameView opens BonusSlotMultipleGame in the restOfGamble3 intro phase.
elixirFurnace.collect: Original sender uses action:gamble, actionValue:false (not a fabricated collect request).
elixirFurnace.choiceConflict: rules_07 says four material types. Original UI re-enables all item nodes but does not prove backend acceptance of selecting the same type twice. This simulation requires four distinct types; duplicate logical-id retry is still safe.

jpGame.initial: pickPositions:[], actionValues0..11, 12 shuffled ingots with three of each native jp-mini/jp-minor/jp-major/jp-grand category
jpGame.pick: action:collect, actionValue=position0..11; response pickPositions appends {position,category}; last winning category and totalWinnings drive original showResult.
jpGame.finish: Three matches set isFinish/prize/totalWinnings; no invented finish request is required by native UI.

fortuneLanding.collect: action:collect, token=that exact locally-issued box token, actionValue=its amount. Any amount/token mismatch is rejected. Uncollected actionOptions remain for resume.
fortuneLanding.finish: action:finish; permits missed boxes; marks isFinish and awards no extra amount.

nativeFields.luckyWealth: bonusType:luckyWealth, prize:number; original GameState passes {win:prize} to LuckyWealthView and settles on closeSpin.

entry.minimum: One valid ordinary engine.gameState trigger stage is sufficient when no ordinary winning presentation chain precedes it. engine.bonusState is separate, never appended as a pseudo-gameState lacking view.
entry.elixir: Provide at least three BONUS10 in view plus isBonus:true in engine.bonusState. MG_SPIN_TO_STOP→MG_SHOW_ALL_WIN→SHOW_BONUS_WIN→BG_INTRO_ELIXIR_FURNACE_STATE.
entry.other: JP/Fortune/Lucky are dispatched from MG_CLOSE_SPIN_STATE by bonusType after the ordinary chain completes. Preserve every original ordinary erase/result stage when there are ordinary wins.
entry.stages: Mini-game request/response actions update engine.bonusState without resetting engine.gameState or native currentSpinIndex.
entry.board: Original I Prefab five reels midCount3: view3x5. GameData winSymbols uses linear0..14 positions with reel=position%5,row=floor(position/5), not per-reel bitmasks.

closing.elixir: Native BonusGameView completion emits BONUS_ELIXIR_FURNACE_END → MG_CLOSE_SPIN_STATE → closeSpin.
closing.fortuneLanding: HEAVENLY_TREASURES_RESULT_END → DROP_TREASURE_CLOSE_STATE. Actual GameSender.sendFortuneLandingFinishReq sends spin(action:finish), then itself sends closeSpin and emits DROP_TREASURE_RESULT_RESP.
closing.walletGuard: Do not complete pending bonus cash twice. Elixir/JP need isFinish; Fortune must process finish before close; Lucky is immediately completed but cash still waits for native close.

progressHooks.status: staged only; no root project modified
progressHooks.runtime: Defaults to globalThis.globalProjectI; requires runtime.markStage(spinId,currentView) returning status200.
progressHooks.model: Original GameData parsing runs first; local saved index restores parser.currentSpinIndex/currentGameState, five native reel arrays of length3, original linear-position winSymbols, currentViewWin and transformInfo. Stage progress persists after original next-stage parsing.
progressHooks.type: Both original ParseResponse.setGameType and GameLogic.setGameType use engine.gameState[0] and can overwrite saved FG with MG. Local resumed responses instead retain the restored current stage action; nonlocal calls remain original.
progressHooks.states: GET_ALL_STATES decorates only existing native MG_WAIT_RESUME_STATE.transitionTo once per instance. On local saved freeSpin START_RESUME, update original FG style/music/times and START_SCROLL, then enter the original FG_SPIN_TO_STOP_STATE or native DRAGON_STATE when dragonLevel is present.
progressHooks.noSkip: Never emit CHANGE_FG_SPIN_TO_STOP_STATE or NEXT_SPIN during resume. Original GameLogic treats that event as advance, which would skip the saved stage. Normal subsequent source advances still run and persist.
progressHooks.music: Original I EBGM field is FREEGAME (H uses a different key); hook also accepts FREE_GAME for explicit compatible namespaces.
progressHooks.boundary: No replacement states/game loop, wallet change, timer, fake completion callback or source asset regeneration. Exact partially played animation time is not persisted; current original phase is replayed from its saved stage.
